body_lead: Telangana Launches AI-Powered Emergency Response System 112 Telangana Police launched the NextGen Dial-112 Emergency Response Support System, also called the AI-enabled Telangana Emergency Response Support System (TG-ERSS), on 5 August 2026 at the Telangana Integrated Command and Control Centre (TGiCCC) in Hyderabad. The upgraded platform integrates 18 emergency services under the national emergency number 112 and uses artificial intelligence for call filtering, incident prioritisation, smart routing, and voice-to-text transcription.
